gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype and the WHO Grade 4 of astrocytoma, IDH-mutant by WHO 2021 classification of brain tumors, non-resectable or partially resected or resected.

candidate_evidence.quote: Weekly ADI-PEG 20 (36 mg/m2) or placebo will be combined with Stupp Protocol (Stupp 2005) radiotherapy and TMZ

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase 1-2 Trial of ADI-PEG 20 Plus Radiotherapy and Temozolomide in Subjects With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: ADI-PEG 20 Plasma Concentrations are measured over time

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacodynamics of ADI-PEG 20: Citrulline and Arginine plasma concentrations are measured over time

role_evidence.quote: Weekly ADI-PEG 20 (36 mg/m2) or placebo will be combined with Stupp Protocol (Stupp 2005) radiotherapy and TMZ

agents.drug_class_hint: ADI-PEG 20, pegylated arginine deiminase (pegargiminase), arginine-depleting enzyme

role_evidence.quote: Radiotherapy and TMZ are standard front-line therapy for newly diagnosed GBM.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

coder_notes: Placebo arm is the registered PLACEBO_COMPARATOR; placebo not listed as an agent. Eligibility includes both IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named; IDH is diagnostic, not an entry requirement, and not listed. PK is plasma only; plasma arginine/citrulline pharmacodynamics coded as target engagement. 'Argininosuccinate synthetase' appears only in keywords and the primary outcome refers to unspecified 'associated biomarkers', so no tumour biomarker row is recorded. Registry phase is PHASE2 although the title says Phase 1-2.
